messages:
Rachael (CEO): thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands about hiring & org changes. i'll leave this thread open for any clarifying q's. will answer through the day and share links.
Anya (People Ops): thanks! can you clarify whether the hiring pause mentioned applies org-wide or just non-customer-facing roles? :thinking_face:
Rachael (CEO): Good q. pause is scoped: it's a short freeze on non-critical net-new hires for Q2 while we finalize Dedicated capacity commitments. backfills and a small list of critical roles still go forward. will post the list shortly.
Devin (Eng Manager): by "critical roles" — does runtime/serving stay prioritized? our latency work depends on a couple of hires we already approved.
Rachael (CEO): yes — runtime/serving and reliability for Dedicated are top-priority. think of it as "customer-impacting infra and revenue-enabling" first.
Maggie (Product): any guidance on PM hiring? we had two reqs in pipeline for Private launch support.
Anya (People Ops): PMs that directly support Private launch and the Dedicated onboarding flow are greenlit. everything else queued for review. timeline: we expect final sign-off by end of next week.
Ashok (Infra Eng): will teams be consolidated? i heard a rumor about moving some eng-infra folks under eng-platform.
Rachael (CEO): consolidation only where it creates clearer ownership. eng-infra and eng-platform will share a lead for scheduling and capacity planning, but we won't dissolve teams mid-quarter. ops for existing projects stays put.
Sam (Senior IC): curious about leveling/IC progression — will we still hire at senior+ bands or cut to junior only?
Anya (People Ops): still hiring senior ICs for scarce skills (model serving, kernel ops). volume hires will skew junior/mid. compensation bands unchanged.
Devin (Eng Manager): can we get a public list of the approved roles so managers can prioritize referrals?
Anya (People Ops): yes — uploading the approved role list and hiring playbook to the HR drive now. link: https://drive.redwood.example/approved-hiring-q2
OpsBot: Recording and slides from today's all-hands uploaded — https://meetings.redwood.example/allhands-2026-03-23
Rachael (CEO): thanks all. quick recap: prioritized hires = runtime/serving, reliability, Dedicated customer-facing roles, Private launch PMs; short freeze on non-critical net-new roles; final list by end of next week. pls direct any confidential questions to @Anya (People Ops).
Sam (Senior IC): :thumbsup: thanks — appreciate the clarity.
Maggie (Product): will follow up with specific PM req ids shortly.
Devin (Eng Manager): tagging hiring leads to review backlog — @Ashok @Anya :eyes:
Ashok (Infra Eng): will do, thanks.
Anya (People Ops): noted — i'll send a calendar invite for a sync with hiring managers tomorrow 10am PT.
Rachael (CEO): perfect. closing the loop here but will keep monitoring replies. :rocket:
